spec.name: Nadia
spec.archetype: meticulous planner who freezes at trade execution

versions.statement: Nadia is exceptionally thorough in developing detailed trading plans, ensuring each plan addresses multiple scenarios.
Nadia becomes anxious and paralyzed by indecision when faced with significant market volatility, causing her to hesitate in executing trades.
Nadia aims to consistently execute trades according to her pre-determined plans without freezing during critical moments.
Nadia prefers structured and methodical learning environments that provide clear and predictable outcomes.
Nadia manages her time with precision, allocating specific blocks for market research and plan development.
Nadia enjoys conducting detailed post-trade analyses to understand market movements and refine her future trading strategies.
